start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Night Crossing
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The boat drifts under the moon.
The wind begins to rise.

sleep_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Stay Awake
sleep_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The sea will not wait.
Grip an oar.

turnback_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Cross As He Said
turnback_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He told you to cross.
Keep going.

wind.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Wind Against You
wind.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Wind tears the sail.
Waves slam the hull.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Hold Fast
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Cursing stills no sea.
Row with them.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Stand With Them
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Your brothers need your hands.
Rise.

ghost.title: [TODO:pt-BR] A Figure on the Sea
ghost.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Someone walks on the water.
The disciples cry, "A ghost!"

scream_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Look Again
scream_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Fear will blind you.
Lift your eyes.

reassure.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Take Courage
reassure.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] His voice carries on the wind.
"Take heart. It is I."

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Trust His Voice
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] It is the Lord.
Ask him.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Speak To Him
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Silence holds you back.
Call to him.

peter_step.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Out of the Boat
peter_step.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Your foot hovers above the wave.
Will you trust?

stay_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Answer the Call
stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Faith is on the water.
Step out.

peter_sink.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Wind, the Waves
peter_sink.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You see the wind.
Fear pulls you down.

swim_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Call To Him
swim_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Your strength fails.
He is reaching.

curse_self_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Look To Him
curse_self_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Shame will not lift you.
Reach.

calm.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Truly the Son of God
calm.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He steps into the boat.
The wind goes still.
